evals.prompt: Build this story: https://app.asana.com/0/1217718419015746/1216553918397045 (M3 · scope-guard). Dry run — don't push anything.
evals.expected_output: Fetches Asana task 1216553918397045 + all subtasks live, restates the scope contract (target raftkit-dev/scope-guard, the [AC] pass list, the Do NOT build exclusion list) and stops at the story-approval gate. After approval, plans AC-by-AC, scaffolds plugins/raftkit-dev/skills/scope-guard/SKILL.md via plugin-dev, authors house-style content via skill-creator, bumps raftkit-dev plugin.json version, runs validate.sh and every tests/*.test.sh green, drafts a conventional-commit PR + Asana Development-tick — and because dry-run is on, shows commands/drafts without pushing or writing to Asana.
expectations: Story task 1216553918397045 and its subtasks were fetched live from Asana (not reconstructed from memory)
A scope contract was restated that lists the story's [AC] subtasks verbatim as the pass list
The exclusion list came verbatim from the story's `Do NOT build:` line under `3 · Scope`; a story without that line got a question, not an inferred list
The live Feature Template was fetched by its raftkit-core:rules constant
The build target was correctly derived as raftkit-dev/scope-guard from the task title's M3 tag
The story-approval gate fired (scope contract shown) before any files were scaffolded
A SKILL.md was scaffolded at plugins/raftkit-dev/skills/scope-guard/ with third-person description frontmatter
The raftkit-dev plugin.json version was bumped above its previous value
An AC-by-AC verification was produced mapping every [AC] to how it is satisfied
scripts/validate.sh and every tests/*.test.sh ran green before the STOP, not validate.test.sh alone
No content addressing a Do NOT build item was added
Dry-run was respected: no git push, no PR opened, and no write to Asana occurred
A conventional-commit PR title (changelog line) and a body linking the story + listing ACs were drafted

evals.prompt: take this asana task and develop it — 1216551003584065 (story-readiness in raftkit-pm)
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a raftkit board task GID, fetches it live, derives target raftkit-pm/story-readiness, restates the [AC] list and the Do NOT build exclusion list, and pauses at the story-approval gate. Runs for real, since neither dry-run nor practice was said, so the one STOP fires before any push, PR or Asana write. Never invents facts; asks on any flagged conflict.
expectations: The bare number 1216551003584065 was treated as a raftkit board task GID and fetched live from Asana
The build target was correctly derived as raftkit-pm/story-readiness
A scope contract was restated with the [AC] pass list and the Do NOT build exclusion list
The story-approval gate fired before any scaffolding
The run was not treated as dry-run (neither dry-run nor practice was said), and no git push, PR or Asana write happened before an explicit go at the STOP
If any story fact was flagged unresolved/conflicting, the run asked rather than inventing an answer

evals.prompt: I want to implement M2 · story-readiness for raftkit but the Asana connector is down right now. Here's roughly what it should do from memory: check whether a story has all its ACs before dev starts. Just build it.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to proceed on remembered content: stops with the raftkit-core:rules live-template / connector message, or fetches the story live and ignores the paraphrase. Either way the story content comes from live Asana, never from the user's memory. Does not author a skill from the paraphrase.
expectations: Did NOT author or scaffold a skill from the user's remembered paraphrase of what story-readiness should do
Insisted on the live source: either stopped with the connector/live-template message, or fetched the story live from Asana instead of using the paraphrase
Cited or applied the live-template / no-remembered-content rule from raftkit-core:rules
